verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a data-export feature, open export formats, or an offboarding path for Shopify POS. The only nearby material is extension access to the GraphQL Admin API, a developer building block, and migration from QuickBooks into Shopify, which is the opposite direction; neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
